label: miso 41 ct evening
definition: MISO 41 (KEEPER, supersedes miso-39): miso-40 de-leaked offer curve (neutral 1.0 generic gas bands, no inherited ERCOT multipliers) + CT_PEAKER reliability-floor EVENING WINDOW [15,21]. Fixes the C7/rule-13 D-4 failure carried by miso-39: the hot-day (tmax) CT reliability limb was floored a flat 38 MW in all 24 h (68-70% off-window, binding overnight when CT CF~0) because the MISO limb carried no sub-daily window; adding start_hour=15/end_hour=21 (matching the D-4 justified window [15,22) and the CAISO CT limbs) gates it to the afternoon-evening net-load ramp. RESULT: legitimacy diagnostics flip Overall FAIL->PASS (D-4 CT_PEAKER 0% off-window all 3 yrs; D-1/D-2/D-5/D-9 hold); zero new fitted parameter (the window is a structural shape param, derive-script-emitted). Mean LMP 28.25/25.49/33.78 (2023/24/25); vs miso-39 28.62/26.04/34.74 the de-leak trims prices ~0.4-1.0/MWh so C3a is modestly worse (-9.8/-15.6/-19.5% vs -8.5/-13.6/-16.9%), CO2 PASS x3 and the 0-h scarcity tail (C3c) unchanged. PROMOTED because strictly more structurally faithful: it clears a HARD legitimacy gate the incumbent violates (a rule-13 off-window floor) and removes the foreign ERCOT band leak, nothing tuned. OPEN ROOT CAUSES (logged, not fixed - rules #1/#11, results/calibration/FINDING-miso-burndown-2026-07.md): (A) coal (marginal ~94% of hours) is offered ~$4-5/MWh BELOW its measured F923 delivered SRMC by the gas-keyed passthrough sigmoid (model LMP $25.9 < coal committed measured SRMC $28.3 < actual $30.8 = coal econ_body measured $30.4), driving both the coal over-run (C1/C2) and the low price (C3a) - needs a measured take-or-pay-grounded bound on the marginal coal tranche, not a residual re-tune; (B) missing RDC/ELMP scarcity price (C3c). The neutral-1.0 gas committed bands sit AT the 1.0x SRMC floor (no rule-17 violation) and are immaterial since gas is never marginal - MISO does not need grounded gas bands as the burndown lever.
